name: menu
title: menu family + parts factory
description: The option list family — item, selectableItem, label, separator, shortcut, subTrigger, itemIndicator. Zero variants. Plus createMenuParts(P): a factory that takes a Base UI menu namespace and returns the styled wrappers (Item, SelectableItem, Label, Separator, Group, Shortcut, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup, RadioItem, SubTrigger, SubContent, Content, Sub). Shared by dropdown-menu, context-menu, select and combobox.
